name: PBR-NeRF
aliases: Inverse Rendering with Physics-Based Neural Fields
definition: An inverse rendering model that jointly estimates scene geometry, materials, and illumination by extending the NeILF/NeILF++ neural fields framework with two novel physics-based priors: Conservation of Energy and NDF-weighted Specular Losses.
summary: PBR-NeRF is an inverse rendering model that jointly estimates geometry, materials, and illumination by enforcing physics-based priors to resolve material-lighting ambiguity.
